_comment: Source registry. quality_weight (0-1) feeds confidence scoring: regulators highest, broker official pages high for objective facts about themselves, expert publishers mid-high, self-selected review sites lower.

sources.name: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database
sources.notes: Official US government complaint database. Covers consumer financial products (banking, money movement); classic brokerage disputes usually go to FINRA/SEC instead, so absence of a broker here is a coverage gap, not a clean record.

sources.name: Investopedia
sources.notes: Publishes annual online broker reviews and awards with a documented methodology.

sources.name: StockBrokers.com
sources.notes: Annual review with published category-level scoring.

sources.name: NerdWallet
sources.notes: Star ratings with published methodology; site monetizes via affiliate relationships (disclosed).

sources.name: Bankrate
sources.notes: Broker reviews and awards; affiliate-monetized publisher.

sources.name: Forbes Advisor
sources.notes: Broker ratings; affiliate-monetized publisher.

sources.name: Kiplinger
sources.notes: Periodic online broker survey rankings.

sources.name: Barron's
sources.notes: Annual Best Online Brokers ranking; much content paywalled — only publicly visible results are used.

sources.name: The Motley Fool Money (The Ascent)
sources.notes: Broker ratings; heavily affiliate-monetized publisher.

sources.name: Reddit
sources.notes: High-signal but self-selected; themes are distilled from recent threads.

sources.name: Bogleheads Forum
sources.notes: Experienced long-term investor community; skews toward index-fund investors.

sources.name: Trustpilot
sources.notes: Self-selected reviews; large brokerages skew heavily negative here regardless of quality.

sources.name: Better Business Bureau
sources.notes: Complaint-driven; useful for issue categories more than star ratings.

sources.name: Sitejabber
sources.notes: Low review volume for most brokers; not yet collected in MVP (marked unavailable).

sources.name: Apple App Store
sources.notes: Aggregate mobile ratings; very large sample sizes but ratings prompts inflate scores.

sources.name: Google Play
sources.notes: Aggregate mobile ratings for Android apps.

sources.name: Fidelity.com (official)
sources.notes: Primary source for Fidelity's own pricing/features. Objective facts only; marketing claims excluded.
